verdict.rationale: Unstructured documents a public REST API callable with cURL or Postman, plus a Python SDK, for partitioning, enriching, chunking and embedding files. The API docs also cover the rest of the product: creating, updating, running and deleting workflows; triggering and monitoring jobs and downloading results; and managing source connectors. An llms.txt is also published for agent consumption. Missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404) and independent hands-on corroboration of driving the API.
